subject: drop in facet_grid and facet_wrap (Plot Builder)

messages.author: 1a09129d38549286
messages.subject: drop in facet_grid and facet_wrap (Plot Builder)
parts:
Hi all, I have detected a bug and got a feature request regarding to the facet elements of the Plot Builder. They are related to the issue of keeping/dropping levels of factors that was already discussed some months ago:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/deducer/a4y8xOoz6Bo

Both facet_grid and facet_wrap admit the argument "drop", to define whether the "unused" levels of the chosen factors should be ignored, or printed in empty facets.
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/facet_grid.html
http://docs.ggplot2.org/0.9.3.1/facet_wrap.html

The Plot Builder provides a "drop" checkbox for facet_wrap. But when it is unckecked, the argument that is set to FALSE is "as.table", not "drop".

In the case of facet_grid there is no such checkbox. That's not a bug of course, just an "absent feature", but I think that it would be nice to have it there too.

Best regards,
Helios

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: drop in facet_grid and facet_wrap (Plot Builder)
parts:
Fixed in the dev version and feature added. It will be in the next release. I also fixed a layout issue with the facet widget being too squeezed vertically.


ian
